Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: byar-c.png, production animation sprite sheet for Riley Wheel Brawl 2.0.
Use attached master-side.png as the LOCKED character design reference. Generate a NEW sheet of the exact same Jaret Byar character, outfit, face, weapon and shield, faithfully matching reference ink and rendering.
OUTPUT: 1536x1024 landscape PNG with genuinely TRANSPARENT background and real alpha. Exactly EIGHT full-body figures in TWO rows of FOUR, reading order left to right then next row. Invisible cells each 384x512. Same character scale throughout (reference proportions scaled uniformly to fit sheet); make large but allow complete sword, shield, boots and cloak within each cell, transparent margins and clear gaps, absolutely no overlapping neighboring sprites. Shared boot baseline within each row. No visible grid, text, numbers, borders, floor, shadow, scenery, effects, dust or motion lines.
Character: tall gaunt stern 40-year-old man, long bony angular face, hollow cheeks, dark deep-set eyes, thin mouth, short dark hair grey temples, no helmet. Exact reference white muddy ragged long cloak and white tabard, gold sunburst on left breast with two gold rank knots below; steel breastplate and layered pauldrons, grey chainmail, steel gauntlets and greaves, brown strapped boots, brown belt. LEFT arm carries the same tall white kite shield with large gold sunburst and gilded rim; RIGHT hand the same long straight steel longsword with gold crossguard and brown grip. Fixed sword length, blade width and shield dimensions in every pose; allow natural foreshortening only. Exactly two arms and two legs, two booted feet, anatomically correct hands. Match reference confident dark brown/near black outlines, thick silhouette and thinner interiors, hand-drawn HD fighting-game art in spirit of Streets of Rage 4, 2-3 step cel shading and subtle painterly gradients, rich grounded colors, soft upper-left light and gentle cool right rim. No pixel art, 3D, photorealism, chibi, blood or gore.
All eight figures face LEFT (side profile/slight 3/4), with only the requested head turns:
TOP ROW:
1: VOLLEY CALL start. Steps back toward right, weight shifting to rear boot, raises right sword arm, sword rising diagonally, shield kept forward on left arm.
2: Sword thrust straight VERTICALLY UP to sky, right arm extended high, head tilted back, mouth open shouting command, shield at left side.
3: Holds sword high vertically, distinct next beat, turns head up and back over his RIGHT shoulder toward unseen archers on right while torso remains oriented left.
4: SIGNAL. Swings sword down and holds it pointing horizontally FORWARD LEFT, shouting Loose with open mouth (do NOT render words), committed commanding forward lean, shield remains on left arm.
BOTTOM ROW:
5: End volley call, lowers sword into normal left-facing guard, shield UP, knees slightly bent.
6: RAGE. Right fist clenched firmly around sword grip, left fist gripping shield, hunched shoulders, teeth gritted, glaring blazing eyes, rigid tense pose; sword lowered at his side.
7: RAGE ROAR. Head thrown back, mouth wide open shouting, sword arm and shield arm SPREAD WIDE, chest lifted; keep both weapons inside cell and full body.
8: RUSH. Fast lunging run to LEFT, body LOW and leaning forward, front leftward boot extending and rear boot pushing off, sword held BACK toward right, shield leading toward left, cloak streams right.
Every frame is a genuinely distinct newly drawn successive moment, never duplicated or mirrored. Maintain identical design across all eight. Background must be actual alpha transparency, not painted checkerboard.
